title: Bishkek rally/march supporting detainees in the Kempir-Abad case
notes: K-News (S011) describes the rally as around 30 relatives/close associates, below 50. Kloop (S007) reports about 30 detained and RFE/RL (S015) says “dozens,” neither establishing a larger total. K-News body explicitly attributes only the route/detention passage to 24.kg (line 38); that limited passage is not independent corroboration. Police detention/dispersal are documented but do not change the attendance threshold. No exact count is reported.
